definitions.full: H2144. Zeker I. [ זֶ֫כֶר ] proper name, masculine only זָ֑כֶר 1Chr 8:31 ( ᵐ5 Ζαχουρ ) = זְכַרְיָה 9:37 q. v. (compare Phoenician proper name זכר ).
